Answers.content:
To convert the fraction \(\frac{3}{20}\) to a decimal, you can perform the division of the numerator by the denominator. Specifically, divide 3 by 20.

\[
\frac{3}{20} = 3 \div 20 = 0.15
\]

This method works because dividing the top number (numerator) by the bottom number (denominator) gives you the decimal equivalent of the fraction.
